proof_availability.classification_scope: Recover generator only up to ONE POSITIVE GLOBAL CLOCK; no absolute rates or entropy production per physical time. Equilibrium symmetric barriers are blind, and bridges/articulation blocks can leave distinct scales. Sufficient cycle/biconnectivity assumptions are NOT a full necessity characterization of constrained physical inverse problems. No uniform finite-data guarantee or experimental capability/advantage. The earlier audited blind theorem with 3-vertex-connected selected graph remains valid HISTORY, but graphic-matroid recognition, Whitney reconstruction and row-permutation alignment are UNNECESSARY. CORRECTION.md and its independent audits govern: a CLASSICAL relative-response maximum principle identifies endpoints directly. Hunter2002 Corollary4.1.2/page93 is a direct DTMC relative-response predecessor, not claimed to contain the whole CTMC full-generator theorem. No priority clearance or newly discovered maximum principle.
